item.title: Octopus Energy denies it is anti-union as GMB pushes for recognition for workers
item.summary: Union says that as a top-rated ethical company, UK’s largest energy firm should welcome its involvement GMB is pushing for union recognition at the UK’s largest energy company, Octopus Energy, known as a progressive organisation with a focus on renewable energy. The union is planning to submit a formal proposal for voluntary recognition at the London-based company and says Octopus, as a top rated ethical business, should welcome the involvement of trade unions.
